scaleBeatText: 👑 Speakers from Emberhold, Stonebridge, The Red Table ride in for the first court — and every one of them is measuring you. FEAST them from a shared granary (5,000 kcal, no strings), HOST the court at Haven's fire (your speaker's time), or write the law in COLD ink (they'll pay more and love you less). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

◈ SYSTEM: "32. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,000 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."
📺 CONTEST: The Oath. Swear three binding oaths on camera. Mean every word — the binding hears the difference.
📺 The Oath. Swear three binding oaths on camera. Mean every word — the binding hears the difference.
This is the one that matters. The audience knows it. Sigrun knows it. The bracelet clicks shut, and the galaxy witnesses the binding.
📺 "Throw yourself at the belt" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.
📺 "Spare the fever-root" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.
